Reflection selects complete successful paths and the key initial mistake from failures. For CMMR-VLN, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of panoramic navigation evidence.

evidence.paraphrase: A fixed reflection strategy admits selected route experiences after each navigation episode. For CMMR-VLN, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of panoramic navigation evidence.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (panoramic navigation evidence) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
